crossRefs.note: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land…
surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the…
For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…
except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his…
Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.
Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children…

parallels.note: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Kenaz
people.line: Father of Othniel, a judge of Israel

translations.web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh completely.’
translations.bsb: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’
translations.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
translations.asv: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed Jehovah.
